safety_notes: Before touching the belt, pulleys, take-ups or gearbox, the drive must be locked out at isolator MCC-2 and zero energy verified (manual section 6.1).
Tracking must never be adjusted with guards removed while the belt is running.

limits.label: motor current
limits.note: Between 11.0 and 12.1 A sustained: investigate within the shift (tracking, debris, tension, oil).
limits.action_high: The relay trips with F-12 above this.

limits.label: belt tracking offset
limits.action_high: Belt is not centred within 10 mm; see tracking procedure section 3.1.

training.title: TL-600 conveyor lockout and tracking
training.intro: Three questions on isolating the conveyor, adjusting tracking and motor current.

questions.ask: Before touching the belt or pulleys, how do you make the conveyor safe?
questions.explain: Stop the line, isolate the drive at MCC-2 with a personal lock and tag, verify zero energy by pressing START, and refit every guard before restoring power.

questions.ask: How much can you turn the tail take-up screws in one adjustment?
questions.explain: Quarter turns only, at most one full turn per adjustment, then run the empty belt five minutes before adjusting again.

questions.ask: At what motor current does the relay trip with F-12?
questions.explain: Normal full-load current is 9 to 11 amps; above 12.1 amps the relay trips with F-12.

sessions.summary: Tracking adjusted two turns; drift and F-12 persist; current 11.8 A.

evidence.title: Belt drifting about 15 mm to the operator side at the tail end
evidence.detail: Meera Pillai: "Belt is walking about fifteen mil towards the operator side at the tail."

evidence.title: Tail pulley take-up adjusted two full turns (operator side)
evidence.detail: Recorded on WO-2214. Manual section 3.1 limits a single adjustment to one full turn.

evidence.title: F-12 tripped again under full load; motor current 11.8 A
evidence.detail: Meera Pillai: "Tripped again at full load. Clamp meter shows eleven point eight amps." (Nameplate 11.0 A, trip 12.1 A per manual section 5.1.)

evidence.title: OVERLOAD lamp lit; display shows F-12 and 11.8 A
evidence.detail: Model observation from the technician's camera: OVERLOAD lamp appears lit, display reads F-12 DRIVE OVERLOAD, motor current 11.8 A.

evidence.title: Over-adjusted take-up is over-tensioning one belt edge
evidence.detail: Two full turns exceeds the one-turn limit in manual section 3.1; over-tension raises current (section 3.2). Not checked.

evidence.title: Is the belt splice lacing crooked or damaged?
evidence.detail: Manual section 3.1: if drift continues after one turn, inspect the splice. Not inspected yet.

evidence.title: Gearbox oil level not checked
evidence.detail: Meera Pillai ran out of time. Low oil raises drag and can trip F-12 (manual section 4.2).

evidence.title: Shift handoff H-0039 created
evidence.detail: Handoff stored for the next shift.

suggested_next_steps: Check belt tension at both edges (suggestion, manual section 3.2).
Inspect the splice lacing and tail pulley for debris (suggestion, manual section 3.1).
Check gearbox oil level; GX-220 stock should be checked first (suggestion, manual section 4.2).
Monthly PM WO-2190 is due today and covers several of these checks (suggestion).
report.spoken_summary: Last night Meera Pillai adjusted the tail take-up two full turns, but the belt is still drifting to the operator side and the F-12 overload tripped again at 11.8 amps. The cause is not confirmed. Still open: belt tension on that edge, the splice lacing, and the gearbox oil level, which was not checked. The monthly PM is also due today.
